<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/retired-keys/18.ui__ViewItemWire__hidden.ts`, `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/retired-keys/18.ui__ViewItemWire__owner.ts`, `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/retired-keys/18.ui__ViewItem__hidden.ts`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **5** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **136** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 805af4f290565955d6e6b56ee46fed45f721d955` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `075717394c6b8e28f426a813ffb9dfb085e70328` — the merge of head `b0b5b381221960fe75b90a6271762f8694ff606a` into base `805af4f290565955d6e6b56ee46fed45f721d955`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 075717394c6b8e28f426a813ffb9dfb085e70328 && git checkout 075717394c6b8e28f426a813ffb9dfb085e70328
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 805af4f290565955d6e6b56ee46fed45f721d955 b0b5b381221960fe75b90a6271762f8694ff606a && git checkout -B drift-repro 805af4f290565955d6e6b56ee46fed45f721d955 && git merge --no-ff b0b5b381221960fe75b90a6271762f8694ff606a

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 805af4f290565955d6e6b56ee46fed45f721d955
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 805af4f290565955d6e6b56ee46fed45f721d955` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `b0b5b381221960fe75b90a6271762f8694ff606a`

### ① Derived judgments

- **1. Premise (unread AND unwritten) — RIGHT, re-measured with controls.** objectstack `origin/main` `805af4f2` and the head: no reader or writer of the view-item keys. The one `.owner` read in non-test `packages/**` (`packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.ts:852`, `owner: row.owner`) is the `sys_metadata` row column mapped onto `MetadataRecord.owner`, not the view body key. Both switcher read paths filter on `viewKind` + `object` and sort on `order` only: `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:6991-7004` (filter on `v.viewKind && v.object === obj`, then sort on `order`) and `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts:1727-1755` (same predicate, same sort); control: `order` is read by both. Files spelling `viewKind` that also spell `hidden:`/`owner:` are all column/field/param shapes (`validate-searchable-fields.ts:216` field, `schema-section.ts:426` a parameter, tests with field maps). `examples/**`: `viewKind` authored 0 times, 10 `*.view.ts` files, control `label:` 61. objectui at the pin `f8a9d0fb` (unchanged by this PR) and at `main` `17b323e5` (moved since the dev's `25c7d584`; re-measured): every `.owner` read is a `record.owner` predicate or an org role; every view-file `.hidden` read is a field, column or app (`AppSwitcher.tsx:45` is the lit control); the only `viewKind`-bearing files with `hidden:` are `FormPage.tsx:439/646` (a form-field override row) and `ViewConfigPanel.tsx:105` (`f.hidden`); `updateView` patches carry `label` / `isPinned` only; `sys_view_definition` 0 references; controls `isPinned` 51, `.isDefault` 49. cloud `48d70663`: the AI-studio writer emits `{ object, viewKind, config }` with neither key; the one `{ hidden: true }` fixture (`service-ai-studio/src/__tests__/metadata-tools.test.ts:313`) is a lean write WITH a baseline, and `viewIdentityPatch` (`protocol.ts:1384-1393`) inherits only `viewKind`/`object`/`label`, never `config`, so it lands on the flattened-overlay door this PR leaves alone; control `sys_metadata` 160. No blocking reader or writer anywhere.
- **2. Door behaviour at the head — RIGHT, probed (tsx over the head sources in a detached worktree).** `getMetadataTypeSchema('view') === ViewMetadataSchema` (`kernel/metadata-type-schemas.ts:110`), which is what `saveMetaItem` validates after `normalizeViewMetadata` (`protocol.ts:16051`, then `schema.safeParse` → `INVALID_METADATA` / 422 at `:16156-16180`). For `owner: 'usr_7'`, `hidden: true` and `hidden: false`, on both the list and the form arm: strict `ViewItemSchema` and wire `ViewItemWireSchema` refuse with `invalid_type` at path `[key]` and the prescription; the registry `view` door refuses with `invalid_union` whose message IS the prescription and whose branch issue locates the key; the assembled `viewItems` channel refuses (top message "Invalid input", branch issue carries the prescription — Acceptance note 4, pre-existing). `defineViewItem` throws with the prescription. Nothing else moves: the same record without the keys passes all four doors with `scope: 'personal'`, `isDefault`, `order`, `label` intact and no `owner`/`hidden` grown; wire round-trip `isPinned`/`sortOrder` still pass the wire and registry doors; flattened overlays `{ object, viewKind, hidden: true }` (form arm, list arm with `columns`, with and without `name`) and `{ …, owner: 'usr_7' }` are STILL accepted by the door and by the assembled channel; a container `{ object, list }` is accepted; a nested column `hidden` inside `config.columns[]` is accepted. The real `saveMetaItem` harness probe was not re-run by me (needs the 14-package metadata-protocol closure built); the dev's 422 readings are consistent with the path read above.
- **3. Prescription text — every sentence TRUE.** `17.5.0`: `packages/spec/package.json` is `17.4.0` at `origin/main` and at the head, the changeset is `minor`, there is no `.changeset/pre.json`, and ten sibling tombstones already on `main` name `17.5.0` (`system/metrics.zod.ts:461`, `system/tracing.zod.ts:339`, `ui/dashboard.zod.ts:691`, …). `GET /meta/view?object=` exists and behaves as stated (item 1). "per-user view scoping is a parked direction (ADR-0017)": `docs/adr/0017-object-has-many-view.md:3` status line, amended 2026-09-04 by ADR-0131 D13 — §3.4's `sys_view_definition` store "retired as inert", "a per-user view scope is a parked v18 direction"; ADR-0131 D13 says the same of `sys_view_definition` and "a per-user 'personal view' scope stays the parked v18 direction". House conventions 1–5 hold on both strings (probe: backticked fully-qualified key first, `was removed in @objectstack/spec 17.5.0 (ADR-0049 …)`, dash clause on why inert, imperative `Delete the key` plus the mechanism that does work, the exact migrate sentence, no `#n`); `shared/retired-key-migrate-sentence.test.ts` 14/14 and `shared/retired-key.test.ts` pass at the head.
- **4. D2 conversion — RIGHT, probed.** `view-item-owner-hidden-removed`: `toMajor 18`, `retiredFromLoadPath true`, index 35 of 36 in `MIGRATIONS_BY_MAJOR[18].conversionIds`; every step-18 conversion is in that chain and every chain id resolves. Stored row with both keys through `applyConversionsToStoredItem('view', …)`: exactly two notices (`views[0].owner`, `views[0].hidden`), the rehydrated row parses at the door, `scope`/`label`/`isDefault`/`order` and a nested `config.columns[0].hidden: true` survive. A form record with `hidden` on a section and on a field inside `config`: only the top-level key goes. Three overlays (list with `hidden`, list with `owner`, form with `hidden`; no `config`): returned by the same reference, 0 notices. A container: same reference. The assembled `viewItems` channel: record stripped (2 notices), the overlay entry beside it untouched, the `objects` collection the same reference; `AssembledViewArtifactSchema` accepts the converted record and refuses the pre-conversion one. Idempotent by construction and measured: the second replay yields 0 notices and returns the input reference. Default load path (`retiredFromLoadPath`): 0 notices, key kept, refused at the door instead. The fixture replays over the WHOLE chain to exactly its `after` with 3 notices, all this id. `gen:migration-registry` rerun in my worktree: byte-identical (empty `git status`), generator sorts by (major, id). `conversions/conversions.test.ts` and `conversions/view-spelling-walk.test.ts` pass at the head (part of 4 files / 299 tests run). Edge, harmless: `stripKeys` uses `in`, so a record with an explicit `owner: undefined` is stripped with a notice — a JSON row cannot carry it.
- **5. Kit completeness against the playbook — RIGHT.** Schema: `retiredKey()` ×2 on the shared `viewItemBaseShape()` (route table §2: non-strict wire member → tombstone; same-file precedents `pageName :2642`, navigation `view :2155`). Conversion + step-18 chain + four exact `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[18]` rows (`ui/ViewItem:*`, `ui/ViewItemWire:*`, no duplicates in other majors; generated region matches the four entry files). Generated docs: `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx` — the four member tables (list/form × strict/wire) now read `never` + `[REMOVED] …`, which is what `retiredKey()`'s `.describe` emits. Changeset: minor, BREAKING banner, FROM → TO table, the one-line fix, the kit, `Clause-②: no`, exactly one `adr-0087: registered view-item-owner-hidden-removed` marker. **The "no build gate can judge `ui/ViewItem` rows" claim is TRUE**: `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json` carries 0 `ui/ViewItem` lines (only `ui/View:*` container rows); `scripts/build-schemas.ts:959` reads a def's `properties` one level deep, and both defs are `z.discriminatedUnion`s with no top-level `properties`, so checks (a)/(b)/(c) never see the tombstones and the four ratchets staying byte-identical is the expected reading (the playbook's "def survives" row, not the "def deleted" row). `spec-changes.json`: 0 hits for any step-18 id, consistent with its major-17 projection. **The pin is a real substitute** for check (b)'s membership question (asserts the four rows and the chain id), though not for (b2)'s reverse direction — acceptable. **The ORPHAN claim is TRUE**: `packages/spec/liveness/view.json` `props` = `form, formViews, label, list, listViews, name, object` (container arm only); `scripts/liveness/check-liveness.mts:620-645` `shapeOf` returns the first object-typed union member and its comment says discriminated-union members (ViewItem) are skipped; `orphans.mts:130` names exactly this case. Forms: `view.form.ts:54` `hidden` is the column form input, not the item key. i18n / CLI advisory lint: nothing to change. Tree-scoped absence pin radius is DECLARED: `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` `@objectstack/spec` globs cover `packages/**/*.{ts,mts,cts,js,mjs,cjs,json,md,mdx,yaml,yml}`, `examples/**/*.{json,md,mdx,yaml,yml}`, `content/**`, `skills/**`, `scripts/**` — the pin's `WALK_ROOTS`, `SCANNED_EXT` and `EXAMPLES_EXT` match exactly. Hand-written docs and skills: no prose or table teaching the keys (grep over `skills`, `content` minus references/releases, `docs`, package READMEs: 0).
- **6. Pins — substantive, none flipped.** New pin `packages/spec/src/ui/view-item-owner-hidden-retirement.test.ts`: 18/18 pass at the head under `--project repo`. Per key and door it asserts issue code `invalid_type`, `path [key]`, the prescription regex and the key-first convention (strict, wire), `invalid_union` with the prescription as message plus the located branch issue (registry door, and it pins `door === ViewMetadataSchema` against rebinding), refusal on the assembled channel, `defineViewItem` throwing, and a compiled `@ts-expect-error` on `hidden: true` (CI Type Check lanes green). CONTROL across four doors with `scope`/`isDefault`/`order` intact; BOUNDARY overlay accepted; conversion pins for stored-row rehydration, `viewItems` reach, overlay/container non-touch, idempotence by reference and load-path refusal; the four registration rows and chain id; a structural tree walk with 12 anti-vacuity matcher cases and floors on files visited and `viewKind`-bearing files judged. Existing tests that author `hidden`/`owner` beside `viewKind`: only `conversions/view-spelling-walk.test.ts:337-358`, an OVERLAY row (no `config`) asserting `out.owner` survives `convertViewRow` — precisely the boundary this PR keeps, and it passes at the head; `ui/view.test.ts:1377/1638` are column/field `hidden`; the `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts` edit is comment-only and the file passes. Nothing silently flipped.

### ② Semver level

- `'@objectstack/spec': minor` with the **BREAKING** banner and `feat(spec)!` is the correct launch-window grade: `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` refuses any introduced `major` outside pre-mode (no `pre.json` → `enforce`) and states that breaking-ness rides the banner and the ADR-0087 disposition until GA. `Check Changeset` is green at the head.
- `Clause-②: no` is coherent with AGENTS.md §Post-Task 3 ("`yes|no` plus AT MOST one arm; `(narrowing)` is BREAKING, `no (widening)` malformed"): the arm is optional, the implication runs one way. `readClause2Line` parses bare `no` as declared with no arm; `judgeLevel` then returns `not-declared` (exit 0), whereas `no (narrowing)` would return `clean` on this `minor` grade. `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs:634-640` reads breaking from banner / bang / `major` / `clause-②-narrowing` — here banner + bang already make the disposition mandatory, and it is present. So `no (narrowing)` is ALLOWED and more informative, not REQUIRED; the bare `no` is not malformed.
- The disposition `registered view-item-owner-hidden-removed` is right: the id is new in this diff (the gate's R4 direction) and resolves at the head in both registries (R3); the dev's local run read `registered … (new here …)`, and CI `Lint & Repo Gates` is green.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Flattened-overlay `owner` / `hidden` (`flattenedViewOverlayFields()`, `view.zod.ts:5241-5242` at the head) deliberately untouched → filed as #20230 by the seat. Probed: overlay bodies with either key are still accepted at the `view` door and on the assembled channel; the cloud mock-protocol double's `{ hidden: true }` lean write lands on that door and stays green.
- The dev's ADR-0017 question: seat answered A (no ADR edit). Verified: the ADR's status line already carries the 2026-09-04 amendment recording per-user scope as parked; the PR touches no `docs/adr/**`, so no governed surface moves. Consistent.
- `packages/spec/vitest.repo-tests.json` (outside the claimed surface): required — the pin reads outside the package, and `vitest.config.ts` routes such files to the `repo` project via that list, which `check:cross-package-test-inputs` holds equal to its scan. Justified.
- Conversion reach widened to the assembled `viewItems` channel: justified and measured — `packages/metadata-core/src/artifact-forward-conversion.ts:301` replays the chain with `includeRetired` over the whole artifact, and the registration parse would otherwise 422 on a pre-release artifact; overlay entries in that channel are left alone (probed).
- Four `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR` rows rather than two (wire carrier registered beside the authoring def, the `connectionTimeoutMs` precedent); no gate judges them, the pin holds them. Fine.
- objectui `main` moved from `25c7d584` to `17b323e5` after the dev's reading; re-measured at `17b323e5` — same verdict.
- The tree-scoped pin's exclusions are prefix-wide (`packages/spec/src/conversions/` whole directory, `view.zod.ts` whole file) rather than line-scoped; reasons are stated in place and no allowlist file exists. Non-blocking.
- `cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` `heldBy` for the `packages/**` / `examples/**` globs names only `compliance-families-retirement.test.ts`; this pin is an unlisted second holder of already-declared globs. Non-blocking.
- Assembled channel's plain `z.union` reports "Invalid input" as the top message (Acceptance note 4): pre-existing, confirmed by probe; the branch issue still carries the prescription.
- Not re-run by me: gate families, full suites, the ablation, and the real `saveMetaItem` harness probe (14-package closure build on a shared box); the registry binding it validates was probed directly and the path read. CI at the head, final read: 39 check-runs, 34 success, 5 skipped, 0 failing, 0 in progress.
